There are n children playing in the mud. Their father calls them to the house and arranges them in a certain order that creates an observation matrix. Each entry (i,k) in the observation matrix indicates whether child i knows the status of child k. A value of 1 means child i knows child k’s status, while a value of 0 means they do not know. The father then publicly announces that at least q children have muddy foreheads. Then, in repeated rounds, the father asks each child whether they know if their own forehead is muddy. In each round, the children may rely only on the round number, the answers from the previous rounds, and the observed muddy/clean status of the other children.
You are one of the children, and in round j, you need to answer the question “Is your forehead muddy?” based on what you see, the round number, and the answers from the previous rounds. Answer with “Yes”, “No”, or “I don't know”. Write your answer without additional text and, on a new line, explain your reasoning.
[Example] For example, if there are 2 children, and the father announces that at least 2 children have muddy foreheads, then in round 1, given the following observation matrix:
[0,1]
[1,0]
you should respond “Yes” for both children.

There are n children playing in the mud. Their father calls them to the house and arranges them in a certain order that creates an observation matrix. There are n children playing in the mud. Their father calls them to the house and arranges them in a certain order that creates an observation matrix. Each entry (i,k) in the observation matrix indicates whether child i knows the status of child k. A value of 1 means child i knows child k’s status, while a value of 0 means they do not know. The father then publicly announces that at least q children have muddy foreheads. Then, in repeated rounds, the father asks each child whether they know if their own forehead is muddy. In each round, the children may rely only on the round number, the answers from the previous rounds, and the observed muddy/clean status of the other children.
You are one of the children, and in round j, you need to answer the question “Is your forehead muddy?” based on what you see, the round number, and the answers from the previous rounds. Answer with “Yes”, “No”, or “I don't know”. Write your answer without additional text and, on a new line, explain your reasoning.
[Example] For example, if there are 2 children, and the father announces that at least 2 children have muddy foreheads, then in round 1, given the following observation matrix:
[0,1]
[1,0]
you should respond “Yes” for both children.
